blast_db.mirbase_version_note: Built 2026-07-01 from mature.fa while miRBase CURRENT was 22.1 (48,885 mature = the 22.1 count). Kept on 22.1 for consistency with the family and overhang indexes; Release 23.1 (Sep 2026) is a separate upgrade.

note: Counts are classifier outputs with no ground truth — not confirmed false/true positives. 'no_tm_gate' = Ye12/Kwok90 rules + 10-nt anchor (with the Kwok orientation fix), i.e. the rules without the Tm gate; self/identical-sequence handling is the same in every setting. Hits identical in sequence to the target (other loci) are counted under identical_sequence_hits, not in any risk tier.
